Vivid revival of Philip Ridley’s gristly consumerism satire
This is sharp, witty and black beyond the pale.

cn.t: Ridley's outrageous satire about aspiration and moral compromise earns strong praise for its darkly comic examination of how far people will go for their dream home, with critics applauding its sharp social commentary.
